outcome: Foundation next-token prediction improved. Dialogue/reading candidate failed and was not promoted. Basic Korean conversation goal not achieved.
diagnosis: Loss improvement did not transfer to free generation. The model declines 116/135 answerable reading questions and recombines authored phrases. Expected weighted target-token accounting assigns ~58% to only 120 authored dialogue rows and ~22% to 3475 answerable MRC rows. This is a plausible training-balance problem, not a proven sole cause; limited foundation learning and model capacity remain unresolved.
next_experiment: Keep the improved base. First test a reading-only curriculum and example-normalized loss, with answerable accuracy and false abstention tracked separately, before restoring multi-turn prose. Do not merely repeat the failed mixed schedule or claim more tokens guarantee success.

active_general.status: experimental; 6/16 held-out phrasing semantic passes; not a finished dialogue model
